title: Rav Huna Mar son of Rav Nechemyah
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Hyman says he always discusses matters with Rav Ashi, as in Kiddushin 6b, where he said to Rav Ashi, “Thus we say in Rava’s name, like you” (the Rosh’s reading there is Rav Huna Mar son of Rav Kahana); in Gittin 14a he raised a difficulty against Rav Ashi; in Chullin 51b Hyman calls the reading erroneous: “grandson of Rav Nechemyah.” In Chullin 17b: “Rav Huna [Mar, Dikdukei Soferim] son of Rav Nechemyah said to Rav Ashi: You told us in Rava’s name.” In Bava Metzia 47a: “Mar Huna son of Rav Nachman said to Rav Ashi”; Hyman proposes, as in Dikdukei Soferim, Huna Mar son of Rav Nechemyah. As Hyman explains in the entry Rav Huna son of Rav Nachman, he was Rav Papa’s son-in-law; see there.

notes.text: The supplied ר״נ is understood as Nechemyah in the proposed correction by connection with the full heading; the quotation’s full Nachman remains distinct. The grandson-versus-son correction, always assertion and Papa son-in-law identification are Hyman’s claims.

The consulted Kiddushin 6b directly names Rav Huna Mar son of Rav Nechemyah speaking to Rav Ashi. The “always” assertion, Rosh Kahana reading, grandson-versus-son correction, Nachman/Nechemyah reconstruction and Rav Papa son-in-law claim remain Hyman’s; uninspected exact readings are not independently verified.
